handoff: Review approved: AC1–AC3 traced to init-version integration tests; unit, integration file and typecheck green; one nit (plain Error on an unreachable write failure).

findings.title: A failed norn_version write throws a plain Error, not a CliError
findings.detail:
`if (!w.ok) throw new Error(...)` would surface as an internal error rather than a P8 CliError with do_instead. In practice unreachable: an invalid team file is already refused with exit 6 (config_invalid) before this point (checked by hand in a temp repo).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally map a failed write to the same config_invalid CliError the config load gives.
